mapper.select: SELECT e.post AS postName, COUNT(*) AS empCount, CASE WHEN k.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isKey FROM hrm_employee e LEFT JOIN hrm_key_post_config k ON k.post_name = e.post WHERE e.is_del = 0 AND e.post IS NOT NULL AND e.post != '' GROUP BY e.post ORDER BY isKey DESC, empCount DESC
